features.name: TE2++ / Semantic IDE
features.summary: Semantic model editing and authoring.
features.implementation: TE2/TOM editing inside the PbiBench shell.
limitations: Keeps the TE2 WinForms foundation inside net48; broad workflow comparison does not imply equal depth.

features.name: DAX IDE / Query / authoring
features.summary: Everyday DAX workbench with model navigation, local context/help, query results and external analysis.
features.implementation: Query tabs, language assistance and Microsoft engine execution.
limitations: Bounded language assistance; engine validation remains authoritative. Deep timings and plans use DAX Studio.

features.name: DAX Scripts / UDF / Calendar
features.uiLocation: Model tools / DAX authoring / Metadata editors
features.summary: Author reusable expressions and model metadata.
features.implementation: Reviewed DAX scripts, UDF changes and calendar metadata editors.
limitations: Authoring is bounded and compatibility-dependent; the model is not automatically upgraded.

features.name: C# semantic automation
features.uiLocation: Automate / Safe C# Preview / Trusted Legacy
features.summary: 20 curated entries: native routes, Safe Recipes and three advanced text-only drafts; implementation provenance is separate from references.
features.implementation: Safe Preview, TE2 Problems navigation, context macros and semantic snippets.
limitations: Advanced templates are Preview TrustedDrafts: generation/insertion only; compile and trust remain separate. User macros never become Verified Gallery entries.

features.name: Data Preview / Profile / Pivot Lab
features.summary: Inspect bounded model data and aggregations.
features.implementation: Projected DAX previews, profiling and Pivot Lab queries.
limitations: Connected queries have row/cell caps; previews are not complete or representative data.

features.name: BPA / semantic QA
features.summary: Review modeling findings and semantic assertions.
features.implementation: TE2 BPA plus original rule packs, fix previews and assertions.
limitations: Rule coverage and assertion workflows differ. A clean report is not a correctness guarantee.

features.name: VertiPaq / optimization
features.summary: Inspect model storage and optimization evidence.
features.implementation: DMV/VPAX capture, storage signals and bounded benchmarks.
limitations: Available metrics depend on connection permissions and capture format; no embedded DAX Optimizer.

features.name: Semantic View
features.summary: Existing relationship diagram with dependencies, report usage and issues modes.
features.implementation: Evolves DiagramView and TE2 metadata; preserves relationship editing and Undo.
limitations: Layout and analysis are deliberately basic; table roles are inferred.

features.name: PBIP / TMDL / Git / Workspace
features.summary: Review semantic source and workspace changes.
features.implementation: Disk/live/Git comparison and reviewed TMDL synchronization.
limitations: Semantic artifacts only; Power BI Desktop remains the report renderer and author.

features.name: Fabric semantic integration
features.summary: Bring Fabric sources into semantic modeling.
features.implementation: Catalog/schema review and semantic source import.
limitations: Authentication and source capabilities apply; this is semantic integration, not tenant administration.

features.name: Fabric Toolbox
features.summary: Use Fabric utilities in their own application.
features.implementation: Independent inventory, item inspector, export and recent read-only jobs.
limitations: Recent jobs for Notebook, DataPipeline and SparkJobDefinition; manual refresh with bounded history. No job writes or semantic editing.

features.name: AI Context Export
features.summary: Prepare reviewed context for external AI tools.
features.implementation: Provider-neutral ZIP with explicit scope, redaction and review.
limitations: Samples stay off by default. Redaction is not anonymization; export does not invoke an AI provider.

features.name: DAX Studio bridge
features.summary: Send specialist DAX work to an external tool.
features.implementation: Launches DAX Studio with query and connection context.
limitations: Requires separately installed DAX Studio. Its UI and source are not embedded or redistributed.

features.name: CLI / CI engine
features.summary: Use shared semantic services from automation.
features.implementation: CLI commands and repeatable local/hosted validation.
limitations: The official comparison documents TE CLI separately from the TE3 desktop app; command and platform coverage differ.

features.name: DataForge integration
features.summary: Read versioned data/truth contracts.
features.implementation: Companion launch and bounded contract reader.
limitations: Working integration can grow independently through versioned DataForge contracts.

features.name: Embedded Agent
features.summary: Review typed proposals from optional providers.
features.implementation: Strict proposals and explicit preview with optional provider adapter.
limitations: Optional agent proposals remain reviewed; provider and workflow development belongs to the agent lane.

features.name: Semantic compiler prototype
features.uiLocation: Model tools / Compiler / packages / Semantic compiler
features.summary: Explore a limited semantic intent format.
features.implementation: Bounded YAML intent and reviewed measure proposals.
limitations: Experimental subset only; unsupported joins/filters block proposals. No equivalence proof or automatic source execution.

features.name: DAX package prototype
features.uiLocation: Model tools / Compiler / packages / DAX packages
features.summary: Review local reusable DAX definitions.
features.implementation: Local PbiBench package manifest, pins and reviewed UDF changes.
limitations: Local prototype can evolve in the DAX package lane. No feed, DAXLib manifest compatibility or executable install hooks.

features.name: DAX debugger
features.uiLocation: Not available; Model tools / DAX Explain is separate
features.summary: Track a known debugging capability gap.
features.implementation: Not implemented; DAX Explain offers static guidance only.
limitations: No expression stepping or runtime filter-context debugger. This row is informational, not an implementation commitment.

features.name: Report Studio / PBIR engineering
features.summary: Search and navigate reports with cached lineage; preview bounded batch, offset copy, bookmark and display-name changes; validate, back up, apply and restore.
features.implementation: Separate .NET 10 WPF process over a pure offline PBIP/PBIR index and change-plan library.
limitations: Local PBIR only; writes require the explicit pinned version/schema policy. PBIR-Legacy and unknown contracts remain read-only.
Bookmark edits currently support tested bookmark/1.0.0 and bookmarksMetadata/1.0.0. Table/matrix formatting is detector/preview only.
Wireframes describe metadata; Power BI Desktop remains the report renderer.

features.name: Knowledge/tutorial features
features.summary: Record a parked knowledge-workspace area.
features.implementation: Existing reference material; searchable tutorials are deferred.
limitations: Reference documents remain available. No new knowledge, tutorial or search subsystem is planned in this pass.

features.name: Semantic / report lineage
features.uiLocation: Semantic View > Report Usage; Report Studio > Lineage
features.summary: Trace fields to report usages and review fresh disk impact before native semantic rename/delete/refactor; exchange metadata-only catalogs and display-name annotations.
features.implementation: Relative-block TMDL, immutable semantic catalogs, structural report references and cancellable TE2 events.
limitations: Partial/unavailable models and imported catalog absence stay unverified. Live model association can be unverified.
TOM and PBIR changes require separate plans and recovery; impact handoffs authorize no writes.

features.name: Bravo / Desktop / VS Code launchers
features.summary: Context-aware external process launchers with explicit applicability.
features.implementation: Supported startup arguments; paths and IDs only; replaceable process adapter.
limitations: Tools must be installed/configured. Bravo needs a live server/database; no query or feature deep links.

features.name: Fabric report snapshots
features.uiLocation: Fabric Toolbox > Workspaces > Get report definition
features.summary: Explicitly retrieve a Report public definition into a new local snapshot and open it in Report Studio.
features.implementation: Bounded getDefinition, trusted LRO, strict paths/Base64, hashed manifest and new-directory snapshot publication.
limitations: No report updateDefinition. Fabric authentication stays in Toolbox; snapshots and Report Studio receive no authentication headers or token cache.
Read-only API retrieval can require Report.ReadWrite.All/Item.ReadWrite.All permissions. Persisted report filters may be present; encrypted sensitivity labels can prevent retrieval.
PBIR-Legacy snapshots are read-only in Report Studio.

features.name: Unified shell / Home
features.summary: One product entry point with grouped navigation and local project context.
features.implementation: Compact rail, Home cards, project context strip and independent child modules.
limitations: Child modules remain separate processes; no embedded child windows.

features.name: Design Exchange
features.summary: Export model metadata and validate dashboard/theme JSON for local preview.
features.implementation: Provider-neutral contracts, pinned offline theme validation and read-only proposed layouts.
limitations: No provider/network call, PBIR generation or report mutation; layout is design intent only.
